title: 今日だけの民
creator: けちねこ"neko"
caption_raw:
今日だけの民 / The Just-for-Today Folk

原曲の旋律を残し、壮大なRPG風オーケストラをArt Rock × Post-Rock × Shoegazeへリミックス。真剣な女性ボーカルと戦士たちの合唱が、誘惑に敗れ続ける民の悲哀を勇壮に歌い上げます。仲間は散っても、誓いは明日へ。🍮⚔️

Keeping the original melody, this remix transforms an orchestral RPG epic into Art Rock × Post-Rock × Shoegaze. A solemn female lead and warrior choir sing the heroic tragedy of people forever defeated by temptation. The ranks may thin, but tomorrow’s vow lives on.
style_raw: Cinematic Art Rock, Epic Fantasy Post-Rock, Shoegaze Battle Anthem, JRPG Final Battle Energy. Preserve original vocal melody, lyrics, phrasing and structure. Intro, verses, bridge and outro: one noble female solo, fully sung. ALL choruses: FEMALE WARRIOR CHOIR ONLY, no solo lead; a large, powerful ensemble singing the original chorus melody in bold, full-voiced unison. Every chorus line belongs to the choir, not background harmonies. Heroic collective vocals, battle-hymn intensity, strong melodic delivery, clear diction. Atmospheric delayed clean guitars and emotional piano build into surging distorted guitars, shoegaze wall of sound, driving acoustic drums, marching toms and dynamic bass. First chorus hits with immediate collective impact; final chorus grows more monumental. Sparse, melodically sung bridge; gentle solo outro. Guitars lead, orchestra stays subtle. Earnest, heroic, tragically absurd. Clear choir presence, natural dynamics.
lyrics_raw:
[Intro: Noble Female Solo, Fully Sung, Solemn Melody, Atmospheric Clean Guitar, Emotional Piano]

遥か昔より 人は誓ってきた

“明日から痩せる”と…

だがその意思はいつも
深夜の誘惑に敗れ去る

人は彼らをこう呼ぶ

『今日だけの民』


[Verse 1: Serious Female Solo, Restrained Art Rock, Delayed Guitar, Gradual Build]

朝焼けの光の中
白湯を掲げ誓ってた

“今日こそ節制する”と
サラダを選ぶ勇者のように

糖質制限 脂質オフ
唱える言葉は完璧で

だけど夕暮れ迫る頃
揚げ物の影が囁いた


[Pre-Chorus: Female Solo Only, Rising Tension, Marching Drums, Building Guitars]

「ひと口だけ」

その呪文で
幾千もの民が散っていった

“期間限定”

その四文字は
人類には強すぎた


[Chorus: FEMALE WARRIOR CHOIR ONLY, No Solo Lead, Full-Voiced Unison Singing, Original Chorus Melody, Powerful Battle Anthem, Explosive Shoegaze Guitars, Driving Drums]

嗚呼 禁断のティラミス
我が理性など容易く砕く

痩せたい願い抱きつつ
運命のポテチへ手を伸ばす

嗚呼 暴食の刻が来た
聖なる意思など意味はない

カロリー表示を見たあとで
静かに視線を逸らしてる


[Verse 2: Female Solo Returns, Driving Art Rock, Dynamic Bass, Layered Guitars, Powerful Acoustic Drums]

筋トレ動画 保存だけ
再生されず積み上がる

プロテインを買っただけで
少し痩せた気になってる

深夜二時の冷蔵庫
封印は静かに破られた

そこに並ぶプリン二つ
あまりにこうごうしかった


[Bridge: Fully Sung Female Solo, Expressive Theatrical Melody, Sparse Piano, Quiet Guitar, Intimate Emotional Delivery]

「空腹ではない…」

「これはただ…
魂が糖分を求めているだけなのだ…」


[Final Chorus: MASSIVE FEMALE WARRIOR CHOIR ONLY, No Solo Voice, Entire Chorus Sung in Powerful Unison, Original Melody, Heroic Battle Hymn, Monumental Shoegaze Wall of Sound, Thunderous Acoustic Drums, Emotional Catharsis]

嗚呼 “今日だけ”を繰り返し
幾千の夜を越えてゆく

敗北するたび人類は
少しずつ丸くなっていく

嗚呼 それでもまた誓う
“次こそ本当に痩せる”と

だがその瞳の先には
新作スイーツ輝いてた


[Outro: Female Solo Returns, Fully Sung, Choir Stops, Gentle Melodic Phrasing, Emotional Piano, Fading Guitars]

「そしてまた一人…」

「コンビニの灯火へ導かれていく」

[End]

⬇️English

Long ago, humanity made a solemn vow

"Starting tomorrow, I shall lose weight..."

Yet that determination
Was always defeated by midnight temptation

And so, they came to be known as

"The Just-for-Today Folk"


In the light of dawn
I raised a cup of warm water and swore

"Today, I shall practice restraint"
Like a hero choosing a salad

Cut the carbs, reduce the fat
Every sacred incantation was perfect

But as evening drew near
The shadow of fried food began to whisper


"Just one bite"

With that single spell
Thousands of souls had fallen

"Limited Time Only"

Those four words
Were far too powerful for humanity


Oh, forbidden tiramisu
How easily you shatter my resolve

Still dreaming of losing weight
I reach for the chips of destiny

Oh, the hour of gluttony has come
My sacred will means nothing now

After reading the calorie count
I quietly turn my eyes away


Workout videos, merely saved
Piling up, forever unwatched

Just buying protein powder
Makes me feel a little slimmer already

At two in the morning, the refrigerator
Had its ancient seal quietly broken

And there stood two cups of pudding
Oh, how divine they appeared


"I am not hungry..."

"It is merely...
My soul crying out for sugar..."


Oh, we repeat "Just for today"
Through countless passing nights

With every defeat, humanity
Grows a little rounder than before

Oh, and still we swear again
"Next time, I shall truly lose weight"

Yet before our very eyes
The latest sweets were shining


"And so, another soul..."

"Is guided toward the lights
Of the convenience store..."
